beats.say: An 1883 eruption created the loudest sound in history.
The third explosion of that day, that occurred at 10:02 a.m., remains the loudest-known sound in history.
The third explosion was the loudest sound that has ever been measured.
The explosion was heard 3,110 kilometres away in Perth, Western Australia.
The acoustic pressure wave circled the globe more than three times.
Material shot out of the volcano at 2,575 km/h.
